name: CPM Application Screening And Tenant Onboarding
description: Carolinas PM end-to-end workflow from rental application receipt through move-in possession release. Covers Boompay application screening, income and rental history verification, PM approval decision, AppFolio tenant setup, lease preparation, fund collection, document verification, property preparation, and 72-hour move-in follow-up.

stages.name: Application Intake
stages.description: Receive application via Boompay, confirm application fee has been paid, and run comprehensive screening.

steps.title: Receive application and confirm fee paid
steps.instructions: Receive the rental application via Boompay. Confirm the application fee has been collected before proceeding with any screening. Document application receipt date and applicant information.
steps.dispatch_title: Receive application and confirm Boompay fee collected
steps.dispatch_body: Verify application received in Boompay and application fee collected. Do not begin screening until fee is confirmed paid. Document receipt.

steps.title: Review Boompay screening report
steps.instructions: Review the Boompay screening report covering: identity verification, credit history and score, criminal background, eviction history, and income and employment verification. Document all findings and any flags.
steps.dispatch_title: Review Boompay screening report (identity, credit, criminal, eviction, income)
steps.dispatch_body: Review Boompay report: identity, credit, criminal background, eviction history, income/employment. Document all findings and flags.

stages.name: Income And Rental History Verification
stages.description: Independently verify income via pay stubs and rental history via prior landlord contact before escalating to PM.

steps.title: Verify income via pay stubs or bank statements
steps.instructions: Collect and verify income documentation (pay stubs, bank statements, or employer verification). Confirm income meets the property's minimum income requirement. Document verification results.
steps.dispatch_title: Verify applicant income via pay stubs or bank statements
steps.dispatch_body: Collect income documentation (pay stubs, bank statements). Verify income meets minimum requirement. Document results.

steps.title: Verify rental history via prior landlord contact
steps.instructions: Contact prior landlords to verify rental history. Ask about: payment history, lease compliance, property condition at move-out, and whether they would rent to the applicant again. Document all landlord responses.
steps.dispatch_title: Verify rental history via prior landlord contact
steps.dispatch_body: Contact prior landlords: verify payment history, lease compliance, move-out condition, and re-rental recommendation. Document all responses.

stages.name: PM Approval Decision
stages.description: PM reviews all screening and verification results, determines the required deposit, and issues an approve, deny, or request-additional-documents decision.

steps.title: PM reviews full screening package and issues decision
steps.instructions: Review complete screening package: Boompay report, income verification, and rental history results. Determine the required security deposit amount. Issue decision: approve, deny, or request additional documentation.
steps.human_prompt: Review full screening package (Boompay report, income verification, rental history). Determine deposit amount. Issue decision: APPROVE, DENY, or REQUEST ADDITIONAL DOCS.

steps.title: Process PM decision (approval or denial)
steps.instructions: If PM approves: proceed to the approval processing stage. If PM denies: generate a formal denial notice in compliance with fair housing requirements and send to the applicant. Document the outcome.
steps.dispatch_title: Process PM approval or denial decision
steps.dispatch_body: If approved: proceed to tenant onboarding. If denied: generate compliant denial notice and send to applicant. Document outcome.

stages.name: Approval Processing And Lease Preparation
stages.description: Convert approved applicant to tenant in AppFolio and Boompay, send approval letter, set up all charges, and prepare and send the lease.

steps.title: Approve in Boompay and sync to AppFolio
steps.instructions: Mark the applicant as approved in Boompay and sync the applicant to AppFolio. Send the approval letter to the applicant.
steps.dispatch_title: Approve in Boompay and sync to AppFolio, send approval letter
steps.dispatch_body: Mark approved in Boompay. Sync to AppFolio. Send approval letter to applicant.

steps.title: Convert applicant to tenant and configure charges in AppFolio
steps.instructions: In AppFolio, convert the applicant to a tenant. Set up all charges: security deposit (as approved by PM), rent amount, lease preparation fee, Resident Benefit Package (RBP), pet charges if applicable. Verify utility transfer requirements.
steps.dispatch_title: Convert applicant to tenant in AppFolio and configure all charges
steps.dispatch_body: AppFolio: convert applicant to tenant. Configure: security deposit, rent, lease prep fee, RBP, pet charges. Verify utility transfer.

steps.title: Prepare and send lease via AppFolio
steps.instructions: Prepare the lease agreement in AppFolio with all approved terms and send it to the tenant for signature.
steps.dispatch_title: Prepare and send lease agreement via AppFolio
steps.dispatch_body: Prepare lease in AppFolio with all approved terms. Send to tenant for signature.

steps.title: Notify internal teams via ASANA and Monday.com
steps.instructions: Create an ASANA task notifying relevant internal teams of the new tenant. Update Monday.com with the new tenant's information and expected move-in date.
steps.dispatch_title: Notify internal teams via ASANA and Monday.com
steps.dispatch_body: Create ASANA task for internal team notification. Update Monday.com with new tenant info and move-in date.

stages.name: Fund Collection
stages.description: Collect all required funds on the required timelines: holding deposit within 24 hours, security deposit within 24 hours, and remaining charges at least 2 days before move-in.

steps.title: Collect holding deposit and security deposit
steps.instructions: Collect the holding deposit within 24 hours of approval. Collect the full security deposit within 24 hours. Confirm funds are received and cleared. Document all payment confirmations in AppFolio.
steps.dispatch_title: Collect holding deposit and security deposit
steps.dispatch_body: Collect holding deposit within 24h and security deposit within 24h. Confirm cleared funds. Document in AppFolio.

steps.title: Collect remaining charges at least 2 days before move-in
steps.instructions: Collect all remaining move-in charges (lease prep fee, RBP, pet charges, etc.) at least 2 days before the scheduled move-in date. Confirm all funds are cleared before releasing possession.
steps.dispatch_title: Collect remaining move-in charges (2+ days before move-in)
steps.dispatch_body: Collect all remaining charges at least 2 days before move-in. Confirm cleared before possession release. Document in AppFolio.

stages.name: Required Document Verification
stages.description: Verify all required documents are received and on file before move-in: renters insurance, pet liability, utility transfers, HOA registration, and PetScreening.

steps.title: Verify all required pre-move-in documents
steps.instructions: Verify receipt and completeness of all required documents: renters insurance policy, pet liability insurance (if applicable), utility transfer confirmation, HOA registration (if applicable), and PetScreening documentation (if pets). Do not release possession until all documents are confirmed.
steps.dispatch_body: Verify before possession release: renters insurance, pet liability (if pets), utility transfer confirmation, HOA registration (if applicable), PetScreening (if pets). Do not release until all confirmed.

stages.name: Property Preparation
stages.description: Ensure the property is cleaned, maintenance is complete, and a move-in inspection is performed before the tenant takes possession.

steps.title: Coordinate property cleaning and maintenance
steps.instructions: Coordinate professional cleaning and any outstanding maintenance work to ensure the property is move-in ready. Confirm all work is complete before the move-in date.
steps.dispatch_title: Coordinate property cleaning and maintenance for move-in
steps.dispatch_body: Coordinate professional cleaning and outstanding maintenance. Confirm all work complete before move-in date.

steps.title: Schedule and complete move-in inspection
steps.instructions: Schedule and complete the move-in inspection per the CPM Inspection Workflows SOP (cpm-inspection-workflows). The move-in inspection must be completed before possession is released. Owner is charged $150.
steps.dispatch_body: Schedule and complete move-in inspection per cpm-inspection-workflows SOP. Must complete before possession release. Owner charge: $150.

stages.name: Possession Release
stages.description: Verify lease is signed and all funds are cleared, then release possession by providing keys or lockbox codes.

steps.title: Verify lease signed and all payments cleared
steps.instructions: Before releasing possession, confirm: lease agreement is fully signed, all required funds are cleared (holding deposit, security deposit, all move-in charges), all required documents are on file, and the property is move-in ready.
steps.human_prompt: Verify before releasing possession: lease fully signed, all funds cleared, all documents on file (renters insurance, pet docs, utility transfer, HOA, PetScreening), and property is move-in ready.

steps.title: Release possession with keys or lockbox codes
steps.instructions: Release possession to the tenant by providing keys or lockbox access codes. Document the possession release date and method in AppFolio.
steps.dispatch_title: Release possession: provide keys or lockbox codes
steps.dispatch_body: Provide keys or lockbox codes to tenant. Document possession release date and method in AppFolio.

stages.name: Move-In Follow-Up
stages.description: 72-hour check-in with the new tenant and confirmation of Resident Portal access and utility transfers.

steps.title: 72-hour move-in check-in with tenant
steps.instructions: Contact the tenant within 72 hours of move-in to check in on their experience and address any immediate concerns. Confirm they have access to the Resident Portal and that utility transfers are confirmed.
steps.dispatch_body: Contact new tenant within 72 hours of move-in. Check in on experience, address concerns. Confirm Resident Portal access and utility transfer completion. Document responses.
